outcome: composite neonatal respiratory morbidity (including respiratory distress syndrome, transient tachypnea of the newborn, meconium aspiration syndrome, mechanical ventilation, or continuous positive airway pressure)
cohort: Twins delivered between 36 and 38 weeks of gestation.
finding: In uncomplicated dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies, delivery at 36 weeks of gestation was associated with a higher rate of composite neonatal respiratory morbidity compared to delivery at 37 weeks.
